name: Heol Llanishen Fach play area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Heol Llanishen Fach, Rhiwbina, Cardiff, one of the 116 on the council's 2020 list. Refurbished in 2023 with an oak theme, separate toddler and junior areas, swings, a spinner, a wheelchair-accessible roundabout and carved oak logs.
